unmapped.label: Reliability practices
unmapped.raw_text: reliability practices for AI or data systems

parsed.notes:
Your fitness level is required by default; Nice to have is optional. Your daily workout contains responsibilities and does not independently establish skill requirements.
Google Cloud is optional because of the inline preferred marker; its required use in responsibilities does not change that label.
Python and Java are both labeled despite being alternatives, as explicitly named candidate skills.
Agentic workflows maps to agents; multi-agent frameworks additionally names multi-agent systems. No separate workflow-automation requirement is inferred.
The ideally marker applies to having a system running in a real environment, not to the preceding LLM, MCP, RAG, or agent skills.
Common AI tooling ecosystem is left unmapped rather than interpreted as coding-agent tooling or general AI/ML expertise.
No German-language or degree requirement is stated.
